t2.title: Learning to cook an important life skill for everyone
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is learning to cook an important life skill for everyone?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
EVs: Ready for the Mainstream?

Having driven my electric vehicle for several months, I often get asked: are EVs ready for everyone? My honest answer: almost, but not quite yet.

Firstly, for urban drivers with home charging, EVs are absolutely practical. Lower running costs, minimal maintenance, and environmental benefits make them highly attractive.

Moreover, the driving experience is superior – smooth, quiet, and responsive. Once you go electric, petrol cars feel outdated.

However, significant barriers remain. Charging infrastructure is still inadequate in many areas. Long journeys require careful planning around charging stops.

Additionally, the upfront cost remains prohibitive for many buyers, despite long-term savings.

Furthermore, apartment dwellers without private parking face real challenges accessing charging.

Ultimately, EVs are ready for many people today, but universal adoption requires better infrastructure and lower prices. We're getting there!

Are you considering going electric?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi VoltDrive,


I like my car. It is fast. Charging is ok. I want more charging places. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Dear VoltDrive,


I like my new electric car. It is fun to drive and it is quiet. The range is good, but I worry about long trips because there are not enough charging stations. I think there should be more chargers in supermarkets and shopping centers because it is easy to charge when I shop. Also, the charging is slow sometimes. It would be better if the charging was faster. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear VoltDrive Customer Relations,


I am writing to you about my experience with my new VoltDrive. Overall, I am quite happy with the car. The driving experience is very enjoyable; it's smooth and quiet. The range is generally sufficient for my daily commute. However, I do have some concerns.


Firstly, the charging infrastructure in my area is not always reliable. Sometimes the charging stations are broken or occupied. This can be quite frustrating. I think more investment is needed to improve the charging network.


Secondly, while the range is okay for daily use, longer journeys require a lot of planning. It would be great if the cars had a longer range, or if there were more fast-charging stations available. In conclusion, I am pleased with my VoltDrive, but improvements to the charging infrastructure would greatly enhance the ownership experience.


Sincerely,
Zarina Ismoilova
t2.sampleB2:
Can You Really Call Yourself a Grown-Up If You Can't Boil an Egg?

Picture this: you've just moved out, you're starving, and the only thing in your kitchen is a pile of takeaway menus. This is exactly why I believe learning to cook is an essential life skill for everyone.

First and foremost, cooking saves you money. Ordering in night after night quickly burns a hole in your pocket, whereas a home-cooked meal costs next to nothing. On top of that, preparing your own food is far healthier, because you know exactly what goes into every dish.

Cooking also brings people together. Some of my fondest memories are of making dinner with my family, chatting away while something delicious bubbles on the stove.

Of course, not everyone dreams of becoming a professional chef, and that's perfectly fine. Even so, knowing a handful of simple recipes can get you out of a tight spot when the shops are shut.

All things considered, cooking is a skill that pays off for the rest of your life — for your wallet, your health and your happiness. So why not roll up your sleeves and give it a go?
t2.uzSample:
Elektromobillar: Ommaga Tayyormi?

Bir necha oydan beri o'zimning elektromobilimni haydab yurganim sababli, mendan ko'pincha so'rashadi: elektromobillar hamma uchun tayyormi? Mening to'g'ri javobim: deyarli, lekin hali to'liq emas.

Birinchidan, uyda zaryadlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lgan shahar haydovchilari uchun elektromobillar mutlaqo amaliy. Kamroq foydalanish xarajatlari, minimal texnik xizmat ko'rsatish va atrof-muhitga foydaliligi ularni juda jozibador qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, haydash tajribasi a'lo darajada – silliq, sokin va tezkor. Bir marta elektrga o'tsangiz, benzinli mashinalar eskirgandek tuyuladi.

Biroq, sezilarli to'siqlar saqlanib qolmoqda. Zaryadlash infratuzilmasi hali ham ko'p joylarda yetarli emas. Uzoq safarlar zaryadlash bekatlari atrofida ehtiyotkorlik bilan rejalashtirishni talab qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, uzoq muddatli tejashga qaramay, boshlang'ich narx ko'pchilik xaridorlar uchun hali ham qimmatligicha qolmoqda.

Bundan tashqari, shaxsiy to'xtash joyi bo'lmagan kvartira aholisi zaryadlashga kirishda haqiqiy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishadi.

Oxir oqibat, elektromobillar bugungi kunda ko'pchilik uchun tayyor, ammo universal qabul qilish yaxshiroq infratuzilma va arzonroq narxlarni talab qiladi. Biz bunga erishmoqdamiz!

Siz elektrga o'tishni o'ylayapsizmi?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom VoltDrive,


Menga mashinam yoqadi. U tez. Zaryadlash yaxshi. Men ko'proq zaryadlash joylarini xohlayman. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli VoltDrive,


Menga yangi elektromobilim yoqadi. Uni haydash qiziqarli va u jim. Yurish masofasi yaxshi, lekin uzoq safarlar haqida xavotirdaman, chunki zaryadlash stansiyalari yetarli emas. O'ylashimcha, supermarketlar va savdo markazlarida ko'proq zaryadlovchi qurilmalar bo'lishi kerak, chunki xarid qilganimda zaryadlash oson. Bundan tashqari, zaryadlash ba'zan sekin bo'ladi. Agar zaryadlash tezroq bo'lsa, yaxshiroq bo'lardi. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli VoltDrive mijozlar bilan aloqalar bo'limi,


Sizga yangi VoltDrive avtomobilim bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida yozmoqdaman. Umuman olganda, mashinadan juda mamnunman. Haydash tajribasi juda yoqimli; u silliq va sokin. Masofa odatda kundalik qatnovim uchun yetarli. Biroq, menda ba'zi xavotirlar bor.


Birinchidan, mening hududimdagi zaryadlash infratuzilmasi har doim ham ishonchli emas. Ba'zan zaryadlash stansiyalari buzilgan yoki band bo'ladi. Bu juda asabiylashishi mumkin. O'ylaymanki, zaryadlash tarmog'ini yaxshilash uchun ko'proq sarmoya kiritish kerak.


Ikkinchidan, masofa kundalik foydalanish uchun yaxshi bo'lsa-da, uzoqroq sayohatlar ko'p rejalashtirishni talab qiladi. Agar mashinalar uzoqroq masofaga ega bo'lsa yoki tez zaryadlash stansiyalari ko'proq bo'lsa, juda yaxshi bo'lardi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, men VoltDrive avtomobilimdan mamnunman, ammo zaryadlash infratuzilmasini yaxshilash egalik tajribasini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.


Hurmat bilan,
Zarina Ismoilova
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli VoltDrive mijozlar bilan aloqalar bo'limi,


VoltDrive avtomobilimga egalik qilganimga bir necha oy bo'lganidan so'ng, o'z tajribalarimni baham ko'rishni va elektromobilga egalik qilish bo'yicha ba'zi konstruktiv fikr-mulohazalarni bildirishni istardim.


Haydash tajribasi, shubhasiz, sezilarli darajada yaxshilangan. Bir zumda paydo bo'ladigan burilish momenti va deyarli shovqinsiz ishlashi haydashni juda yoqimli qiladi va an'anaviy ichki yonuv dvigatellarini taqqoslashda deyarli eskirgan holga keltiradi. Masofa ham mening odatdagi foydalanishim uchun yetarli ekanligini isbotladi va "masofa xavotiri" haqidagi dastlabki xavotirlarni bartaraf etdi.


Biroq, zaryadlash infratuzilmasi muhim to'siq bo'lib qolmoqda. Shahar hududlari nisbatan yaxshi ta'minlangan bo'lsa-da, qishloq joylarga borish diqqat bilan rejalashtirishni talab qiladi, ko'pincha shaxsiy xohishdan ko'ra zaryadlash nuqtalarining mavjudligi bilan belgilanadi. Bundan tashqari, turli provayderlar bo'ylab zaryadlash tezligidagi nomuvofiqlik katta umidsizlik manbai hisoblanadi. Zaryadlash tezligini standartlashtirish va tezlashtirish elektromobilga egalik qilish amaliyligini sezilarli darajada oshiradi.


Yana bir takomillashtirish yo'nalishi - elektromobillarni kvartira aholisi uchun yanada qulay qilish. Kvartira majmualarida zaryadlash nuqtalarini o'rnatishni rag'batlantirish, hozirda logistika muammolari tufayli to'xtatilgan bozorning sezilarli qismini ochadi. Oxir oqibat, VoltDrive muhim qadam bo'lsa-da, ushbu infratuzilmaviy va qulaylik muammolarini hal qilish elektromobillarni keng qo'llash uchun juda muhimdir.


Hurmat bilan,
Zarina Ismoilova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the car manufacturer. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear VoltDrive Customer Relations,

Thank you for reaching out. I am generally pleased with my new vehicle.

Firstly, the driving experience is exceptional. The instant acceleration and quiet operation make every journey enjoyable.

However, I have encountered some challenges. The actual range is somewhat less than advertised, particularly in cold weather. Being more transparent about realistic range would help buyers plan better.

Additionally, the charging app is not always reliable. Improving software stability would enhance the experience.

Furthermore, offering more home charging solutions at affordable prices would make EV ownership more accessible.

The environmental benefits make me proud to be an owner.

Best regards,
A Satisfied EV Owner
t12.sampleA1:
Hi VoltDrive!


I have a new car. It is electric. I like it. It is fast.


Charging is okay. More chargers please!


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear VoltDrive,


I like my new electric car. It is good to drive and it is quiet. But the range is not very good. I can't go very far.


The chargers are okay but there are not many. I need more chargers near my house because it is hard to charge the car.


I think you should make the car go further and have more chargers. Thank you.


Thanks,


An EV Owner
t12.sampleB1:
Dear VoltDrive Customer Relations,


Thank you for your email. I'm writing to you about my new VoltDrive car. Overall, I am happy with it. The driving is great and it's good for the environment.


However, there are some things I think could be better. The range isn't as good as I expected, especially when it's cold. Also, it's sometimes difficult to find charging stations when I need them.


In my opinion, you should improve the range of the car and build more charging stations in different areas. This would make owning an electric car easier for everyone.


Sincerely,


A VoltDrive Owner
t12.sampleB2:
Dear VoltDrive Customer Relations,

Thank you for getting in touch. On the whole, I am delighted with my new electric vehicle, and I am glad to share some honest feedback.

To begin with, the driving experience is outstanding. The instant acceleration and near-silent operation make every journey a pleasure. However, I have run into a couple of issues. The actual range falls short of the advertised figure, particularly in cold weather, so being more upfront about realistic range would help buyers plan ahead.

In addition, the charging app is not always reliable, and improving its software stability would make a real difference. Finally, I would encourage you to roll out more affordable home-charging options.

All in all, I am proud to drive a VoltDrive, and I trust these suggestions will be taken on board.

Yours sincerely,
Dilnoza Karimova
